item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description: Compare two .aab builds and get the size a device actually downloads. Enabling R8 used to read as a 3.5 MB saving when devices got 11.3 MB back — the archive's copy of the R8 mapping and debug symbols, which Google Play strips, were being counted. A new card names the individual files that moved, and everything Play keeps but never ships is listed separately, out of the total. Also: the app-hang check was wrong more often than right, so it's gone.
